ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the HKTM downlink report was ingested by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder or interface path from which the source report was collected

satellite_id.description: Satellite identifier from the Satellite ID column

mission.description: Mission identifier set by the collector to S2

datatake_id.description: Datatake identifier from the AcquisitionID column

x_on.description: X-band transmitter switch-on time for the HKTM downlink

x_off.description: X-band transmitter switch-off time for the HKTM downlink

effective_downlink_start.description: Effective downlink start time from the EffectiveDownlinkStart column

effective_downlink_stop.description: Effective downlink stop time from the EffectiveDownlinkStop column

downlink_mode.description: Downlink mode from the DwlMode column

downlink_start.description: Downlink start time from the DownlinkStart column

downlink_stop.description: Downlink stop time from the DownlinkStop column

downlink_duration.description: Downlink duration in milliseconds from the DownlinkDuration [msec] column

latency.description: Latency in minutes from the Latency [min] column

station.description: Ground station acquiring the downlink from the Station column

downlink_absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit of the downlink pass (not populated by this collector)

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number (not populated by this collector)

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number from the AbsoluteOrbit column

partial.description: Partial acquisition indicator from the Partial column

interface_name.description: Collector interface name set to S2MissionPlanning

acquisition_start.description: Acquisition start time from the AcquisitionStart column

acquisition_stop.description: Acquisition stop time from the AcquisitionStop column

acquisition_duration.description: Acquisition duration in milliseconds from the AcquisitionDuration [msec] column

number_of_scenes.description: Number of scenes from the Scenes column

downlink_execution_time.description: Downlink execution time (not populated by this collector)
